text:
Alex Martin: Heads-up — noticed payroll flagged 11/11 as the observed day for the UK office but UK public holiday was 11/10 this year. A few folks had PTO deducted twice. @people-ops? :confused:
Jordan (People Ops): Sorry to hear that — can you DM me the employee IDs and the affected dates? Which region exactly? we'll sort this out.
Alex Martin: It's the UK/EU team — ~7 people. Manager told them to take 11/10 as the observed day, but system auto-marked 11/11. Some used personal PTO on 11/11 and then got holiday pay too, so balances got funky.
Sofia (Payroll): looping in payroll. @Jordan — we ran the observed-days normalization; looks like a timezone offset bug in the holiday mapping table. Patch is queued. We can reverse duplicate deductions if you provide the list and manager sign-off.
Jordan (People Ops): thx @Sofia. Alex, please paste the list here or DM. We'll need manager approval for reversals per audit rules. @Priya can you confirm approval?
Priya Kumar (Manager): Confirmed. I approve reversals for the impacted individuals — please proceed. :thumbsup:
Alex Martin: Pasting here (from HRIS export):
- eid:11234 Alice N. — PTO used 2025-11-11, observed holiday 2025-11-10
- eid:11345 Bob L. — PTO used 2025-11-11, observed holiday 2025-11-10
- eid:11456 Carlos M. — PTO used 2025-11-11, observed holiday 2025-11-10
- eid:11567 Dina S. — PTO used 2025-11-11, observed holiday 2025-11-10
- eid:11678 Emma T. — PTO used 2025-11-11, observed holiday 2025-11-10
- eid:11789 Farah K. — PTO used 2025-11-11, observed holiday 2025-11-10
- eid:11890 Gary P. — PTO used 2025-11-11, observed holiday 2025-11-10
Jordan (People Ops): Received. We'll initiate reversal and attach manager approval to the HR audit record. Sofia — can you confirm ETA for the payroll correction and whether any manual journal entries are needed?
Sofia (Payroll): ETA end of day tomorrow for the reversal to be queued; it will show up on the next payroll run. No manual journal entries required unless there are retro tax adjustments; I'll flag if any. I'll run the rollback script and post run logs. Command I'm using:
```bash
python reconcile_holidays.py --rollback --ids 11234,11345,11456,11567,11678,11789,11890 --region EU --note "observed-day-mismatch"
```
SRE Bot: deploy to payroll-prod succeeded at 2026-03-22 15:03:12 UTC
Sofia (Payroll): Rolled back the duplicate PTO deductions and updated HRIS balances. I also created detection rule HR_PAY_008 to flag observed-date drift across locales so we don't re-hit this.
Jordan (People Ops): Great — I'll update the time-off policy note: when a local observed holiday shifts, the system will not auto-deduct personal PTO for that moved date. We'll publish FAQ and a short doc for managers on how to approve reversals.
Priya Kumar (Manager): Thanks — I can confirm employees see corrected balances in the portal. Anything else we need to close out?
Alex Martin: Balances look fixed on my end. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
Jordan (People Ops): Closing this thread and filing incident ticket HR-2026-117 for audit and retro follow-up. If anyone spots related drift in other locales, ping me directly.
